chunks: Al-Hasan b. 'Abdullah b. Sa'id b. al-Hasan b. Isma'il b. Hakim al-'Askari narrated to us... from al-'Ala' b. 'Abd al-Rahman from his father from Abu Hurayra that the Messenger of Allah (s) said:
There may be a beggar who is disheveled, dusty, and wearing two tattered garments, who is refused at the doors, but if he were to ask something of Allah, He would fulfill it for him.

key_terms.أَشْعَثَ أَغْبَرَ: Disheveled and dusty — describing the outward appearance of humble believers
key_terms.أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ: To swear an oath by Allah — indicating deep piety and closeness to God
key_terms.لَأَبَرَّهُ: He would fulfill it — Allah honoring the oath of His pious servants

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about humble, poor believers who are turned away at doors?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad said that there are humble, poor believers who appear disheveled and dusty, wearing tattered clothing and turned away at doors, yet they are so close to Allah that if they were to swear an oath by Him, He would fulfill it.
